summary: This video details three high-performing Aura team setups for Phase 1 of the Mekkatorque endgame boss in Season 8. The setups feature Talethia as the primary DPS, accompanied by Diantha, Lincos, Anneliesis, and a flexible fifth hero: Rena, Shahla, or Naro. The Rena variant achieves the highest output at 2.6 billion damage, while Shahla reaches 2.0 billion and Naro reaches 1.7 billion. Specific gearing, stat requirements, and timing rotations are provided for each setup.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.verdict: Top primary DPS for Aura teams
heroes.note: Requires high crit rate, crit damage, and maximum attack to benefit fully from team buffs.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.note: Enables the highest-damaging Aura setup (2.6B) with a 15-second rotation.

heroes.name: Shahla
heroes.note: Replaces Rena for a 2.0B damage team; grants crit damage buffs to the highest-attack hero.

heroes.name: Naro
heroes.note: Yields 1.7B damage and allows the team to function on both Phase 1 and Phase 2 without changing builds.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.note: Equipped with Prismatic Cloak to reflect boss debuffs and maximize boss vulnerability.

heroes.name: Anneliesis
heroes.note: Requires Skill Haste above 60 and sufficient Accuracy to maintain team skill timing.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.note: Built for high damage and Accuracy to help stack debuffs on the boss.

teams.note: Highest damage variant achieving up to 2.6 billion damage with a 15-second rotation.

meta_changes: Aura teams utilizing Talethia paired with debuff-reflecting supports represent top-tier strategies for Mekkatorque.
tips: Mekkatorque takes increased damage based on the total number of debuffs on the target.
When using Shahla, ensure Talethia has the highest Attack on the team so she receives the crit damage buff.
Maintain over 60 Skill Haste on Anneliesis to preserve optimal timing rotations.
The Naro team setup can be kept unchanged through both Phase 1 and Phase 2 of the boss fight.
